# Measurement

`./builder bench` retains CSV and 10,000-function corpora in `build/bench-data`. Cases: plain C, native syntax, legacy shorthand/indentation, macros. Reports five warm in-process rounds, CLI elapsed time, peak RSS (GNU time), 20-launch startup. Plain C is passthrough, not parsing. C compilation is excluded. Report CPU, OS, compiler and flags when comparing; synthetic results are not universal speed claims.
